scientific_integrity: The proof explicitly treats Kurilić's kernel theorem, equal-kernel-intersection lemma, and 2^k profile bound as prior work. The contribution is restricted to retaining the arity constraint, proving the resulting partial-binomial envelope, and giving a simultaneous sharpness construction.
scientific_limitations: The extremal construction uses a finite language with k unary predicates; fixed-signature extremal envelopes may be smaller.
The theorem concerns induced-substructure profiles rather than ordered tuple-orbit profiles.
The literature search cannot rule out an unindexed or differently phrased earlier observation.
No independent audit has yet been performed.
title: Sharp arity-sensitive profile envelope for almost-chainable structures
